soldier: Head pale brown, mandibles purplish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, setae on the head capsule rather sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.51–0.54, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin straight. Frontal peaks strongly raised, concave between the peaks. Labrum ligulate, shaped like an upright egg, broad and rounded at the apex; apical, subapical and lateral apical setae of similar length. Mandibles short and stout, apex strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge projecting; mandible length 0.48–0.49 times head capsule length and 0.86–0.95 times head width. Antennae 17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum behind about the anterior sixth, the anterior lateral margins parallel and then abruptly widening posteriorly; waist region narrow and elongate, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.29–0.38. Pronotum trapezoidal, about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow concavity, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; nearly 30 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
